name: LW buyback trigger counted from a spot-balance price
summary: LW (GGGTOKEN) increments thanPrice whenever a sell is worth more than 2,500 USDT at getTokenPrice(), a ratio of the pair's USDT and LW balances, and its public receive() spends 3,000 USDT from the market wallet on an LW buyback per unit of thanPrice. The attacker skewed the pair balances with flash-loaned funds so that repeated sells counted as large, then sent BNB to the token to fire the buybacks and sold LW into the USDT they added to the pair.
notes: Immutable token runtime; owner() is zero before the exploit and the creator's later transactions are plain transfers.

USDT pulled from the LW market wallet by the forced buybacks in both attack transactions. The attacker contract kept 48,415.97 USDT; the rest went into the LW/USDT pair and fee recipients. The reported ~$50k is the attacker's take.
